newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Premier Research started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Premier Research started.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said on Thursday it had started coverage of Premier Research Worldwide Inc with a rating of buy.

-- Analysts Karyn Murphy and Edmund Kroll wrote in a report, "We like the growth prospects of the CRO (clinical research organization) industry, driven by its ability to cost effectively outsource the new drug research and development process for drug manufacturers."
-- They set a 12-month target price of $28 a share. "Our 1997 and 1998 EPS estimates are $0.54 and $0.70, respectively."
-- The company's shares opened up 1/2 to 18.
